item.title: Trump threatens Oman, Iran war in stalemate as 60-day talks window ends
item.description: The 60-day deadline for the U.S. and Iran to negotiate a peace deal and reopen the Strait of Hormuz is expiring, with no agreement in sight.

item.title: Trump welcomes 16-year-old lifeguard and boy he rescued to the Oval Office
item.description: President Trump praised lifeguard Ryder Williams for his bravery, saying his rescue of a 10-year-old boy in treacherous waters was "incredible."

item.title: Watch: Trump meets with hero lifeguard, takes questions on Iran, USS Lincoln and more
item.description: President Trump on Monday met with 16-year-old Ryder Williams, the lifeguard who saved a 10-year-old boy who was struggling in rough surf on a California beach. During the Oval Office meeting, the president also took questions from reporters on Iran, conditions aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln and more.

item.title: Watch Live: Prosecution rests in Lindsay Clancy murder trial, defense takes over
item.description: Lindsay Clancy's Massachusetts murder trial is back underway Monday in Plymouth Superior Court with a fourth week of witness testimony.

item.title: Has your license plate been tracked by Flock? Here's how to check.
item.description: The website​ HaveIBeenFlocked has compiled a database of 4.6 million license plate records that have appeared in roughly 242 million Flock searches.

item.title: Retired Marine colonel on Trump threat to bomb Oman: "Pretty extraordinary"
item.description: Mark Cancian, retired Marine colonel and senior adviser at the Center for Strategic and International Studies, joins CBS News to discuss President Trump's threat to bomb Oman if it "gets in the way" of efforts to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Hegseth to go to Iowa today to campaign for GOP candidates, sources say
item.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth was scheduled to head to Iowa on Monday to give remarks, speak to veterans and campaign, sources told CBS News.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy's mother gives emotional testimony in her defense during murder trial
item.description: Paula Musgrove, Lindsay Clancy's mother, gave emotional testimony in her daughter's murder trial on Monday, where she said Clancy was a dedicated, loving mom.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy's sister describes the mom's symptoms during mental health crisis
item.description: Lindsay Clancy's sister, Allison Ozga, took the stand in Clancy's murder trial on Monday to share what her sister's mental health was like before allegedly killing her three children.

item.title: How much can you earn by putting $50,000 in a 6-month CD this August?
item.description: A $50,000 6-month CD could lock in a solid return, especially if you lock in a CD rate before they shift again.

item.title: 58% of Democrats view socialism positively in new CBS News poll on the economy
item.description: A new CBS News poll is digging into how Americans feel about capitalism, socialism and the economy at large with the 2026 midterm elections just a few months away. CBS News' executive director of elections and surveys Anthony Salvanto has more.

item.title: Why are airlines banning humanoid robots from flights?
item.description: Four major U.S. airlines have quietly changed their policies to ban humanoid and animal-like robots from their flights.

item.title: Opening statements in Tupac Shakur murder trial
item.description: The trial has begun for the man accused of ordering the 1996 murder of Tupac Shakur, Duane "Keffe D" Davis. CBS News legal reporter Katrina Kaufman has more.

item.title: Maps and charts show record number of measles cases in U.S. this year
item.description: CBS News has been tracking a record number of measles cases and outbreaks around the country. The majority of cases are among those who haven't been vaccinated.

item.title: Trump threatens to bomb Oman over Strait of Hormuz; CENTCOM commander meets with USS Lincoln troops
item.description: President Trump on Monday threatened to bomb Oman if the country "gets in the way" of efforts to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Meanwhile, Adm. Brad Cooper, the head of U.S. Central Command, is praising the crew of the USS Abraham Lincoln after he visited the aircraft carrier on Saturday. The ship has been at sea for more than 240 days, a record deployment. CBS News White House reporter Olivia Rinaldi has the latest.

item.title: Ex-prosecutor fired over FACE Act case sues DOJ for unlawful termination
item.description: Sunita Doddamani argues that she was terminated as an assistant U.S. attorney because she prosecuted activists accused of blocking an entrance to an abortion clinic.

item.title: Supreme Court won't rehear Trump's appeal of $5 million E. Jean Carroll case
item.description: The Supreme Court declined for the second time to consider President Trump's appeal in the E. Jean Carroll case.

item.title: Hayden Panettiere, known for "Heroes" and "Remember the Titans," dies at 36
item.description: Hayden Panettiere, who starred in "Remember the Titans" as a child actor and rose to fame in the series "Heroes," has died at the age of 36. The coroner's office says she was found in cardiac arrest.

item.title: Prosecution rests in Lindsay Clancy murder trial
item.description: The prosecution rested its case Monday in the Massachusetts trial against Lindsay Clancy, who admitted to killing her three children in 2023. CBS News' Shanelle Kaul has more.

item.title: Trump threatens Oman over Strait of Hormuz as U.S.-Iran negotiation period expires
item.description: President Trump threatened to bomb Oman if it got in the way of efforts to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. Meanwhile, the 60-day negotiation period between the U.S. and Iran expired Monday. CBS News national security analyst Aaron MacLean has more.

item.title: Blanche says no attorney general should pledge independence from the White House
item.description: U.S. Attorney General Todd Blanche, who is President Trump's former personal lawyer, said in an interview that no attorney general should pledge independence from White House. CBS News' Jake Rosen has more.

item.title: Former Hurricane Lala drenches Hawaii, flash floods sweep away Big Island homes
item.description: Lala was weakening but still packing a punch as it moved away from the islands, forecasters said.

item.title: Jared Kushner met with Hamas leaders in Egypt to discuss Gaza peace deal
item.description: Jared Kushner, who is President Trump's son-in-law, is set to meet next with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who rejected the latest peace proposal last week.

item.title: Trial starts in Microsoft exec's murder allegedly hatched by ex-wife
item.description: Jared Bridegan was repeatedly shot outside his vehicle while his 2-year-old child was strapped in a car seat.

item.title: Hayden Panettiere remembered by co-stars and friends after her death
item.description: Co-stars and friends of Hayden Panettiere​ are remembering her for her friendship, intelligence and talent after her shocking death on Sunday.

item.title: Should people be concerned about conditions aboard the USS Lincoln?
item.description: U.S. service members aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln are reportedly struggling with mental health issues amid a record-breaking deployment at sea. CBS News national security analyst Aaron MacLean has more.

item.title: Senior Israeli official calls for killing of "30 to 40" Gazans every night
item.description: Israel's far-right national security minister Itamar Ben-Gvir calls for nightly "targeted assassinations" in Gaza: "They're not even people."

item.title: CENTCOM commander tries to ease concerns about USS Abraham Lincoln
item.description: President Trump and Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth have disputed concerns about conditions aboard the aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln.

item.title: Ukraine could use own ballistic missile against Russia within months, former defense minister says
item.description: Mykhailo Fedorov, Ukraine's former defense minister, joined CBS News' Aidan Stretch to discuss the future of the Russia-Ukraine war, including his belief that Ukraine will launch a ballistic missile into Russia by the end of the year.

item.title: Ex-wife charged in killing of Microsoft exec, may face death penalty
item.description: On Feb. 16, 2022, Jared Bridegan was shot multiple times as his 2-year-old daughter sat in her car seat.
